title: Rajasthani Dance Tutorial -Part 3|राजस्थानी/घूमर डांस में हाथो के 10 बेसिक स्टेप्स |रक्षा राजपुरोहित

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor patiently guides viewers through foundational Rajasthani hand movements with clear verbal breakdowns. She demonstrates each step at a measured tempo from a frontal perspective.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction and welcome to part 3 of the Rajasthani dance tutorial series.
Detailed step-by-step instruction of 10 basic hand steps for Rajasthani and Ghoomar dance.

steps_taught.name: Step 1
steps_taught.description: Fingers joined together, moving right and left while gliding downwards.

steps_taught.name: Step 2
steps_taught.description: Twisting hands and touching the opposite shoulder alternately.

steps_taught.name: Step 3
steps_taught.description: Creating an L-shape with arms and waving while moving side to side.

steps_taught.name: Step 4
steps_taught.description: Twisting both hands outward as if lifting a veil from the face.

steps_taught.name: Step 5
steps_taught.description: Crossing hands in a diagonal path and touching shoulders.

steps_taught.name: Step 6
steps_taught.description: Swaying hands smoothly from side to side with joined fingers.

what_works: Step-by-step numerical counting helps follow the rhythm easily.
Clear visual demonstrations of hand placements and postures.
what_hinders: The dancer's face is covered by a veil, which obscures facial expressions.

quotes.text: अगर आपको राजस्थानी डांस बिल्कुल नहीं आता है तो आपने बिल्कुल सही वीडियो चुना है देखने के लिए।
आज मैं आपके साथ शेयर कर रही हूं कुल दस हाथों के स्टेप्स।

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher speaks to the camera with hand gestures introducing the dance tutorial series.
Teacher stands in traditional attire and demonstrates wrist and finger posture.
Demonstration of Step 1 with hand movements moving right and left.

extraction.distinctive_method: Focuses exclusively on hand and arm placements across multiple progressive steps before combining them with music.
